Orchestrate

CrewAI AMP is built on top of CrewAI's open-source, multi-agent framework. Thanks to advanced AI agent orchestration capabilities and intuitive abstractions, AI agent builders can focus on defining what agents need to do rather than how they need to do it.

Build and integrate

CrewAI Studio allows anyone to build crews of AI agents and equip them with tools such as Gmail, Microsoft Teams, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce and Slack. Alternatively, AI engineers can exercise greater control and precision with CrewAI APIs and integrate both out-of-the-box and custom tools.

Observe and optimize

CrewAI real-time tracing details every step performed by AI agents, from task interpretation and tool calls to validation and final output. In addition, AI builders can take advantage of both automated and human-in-the-loop agent training to ensure repeatable, reliable outcomes.

Manage and scale

CrewAI AMP enables organizations to accelerate and scale the use of AI agents across every business unit, department and team within an organization, providing centralized management, monitoring and security as well as automatic, serverless scaling – whether in the cloud or on premises.

    attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
  });

/**
 * Enhanced Business Email Validation for Webflow Forms
 * Version 2.0 - With custom styling and configuration options
 */

(function() {
  
  // ============================================
  // CONFIGURATION - Customize these settings
  // ============================================
  
  const CONFIG = {
    // Error message text
    errorMessages: {
      invalid: 'Please enter a valid email address',
      freeEmail: 'Please use a business email address',
      required: 'Business email is required'
    },
    
    // Error styling
    errorStyle: {
      color: '#ff0000',
      fontSize: '14px',
      marginTop: '5px',
      fontWeight: 'normal'
    },
    
    // Input error styling
    inputErrorStyle: {
      borderColor: '#ff0000',
      borderWidth: '1px',
      borderStyle: 'solid'
    },
    
    // Submit button disabled styling
    submitDisabledStyle: {
      opacity: '0.5',
      cursor: 'not-allowed',
      pointerEvents: 'none'
    },
    
    // Show real-time validation (true) or only on submit (false)
    realtimeValidation: true,
    
    // Validate on blur (when user clicks away from field)
    validateOnBlur: true
  };

  // List of free email domains to block
  const freeEmailDomains = [
    // Major providers
    'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com',
    'aol.com', 'icloud.com', 'mail.com', 'protonmail.com',
    
    // International variants
    'googlemail.com', 'yahoo.co.uk', 'yahoo.ca', 'yahoo.in',
    'yahoo.com.au', 'hotmail.co.uk', 'hotmail.fr', 'outlook.co.uk',
    
    // Other popular free providers
    'yandex.com', 'yandex.ru', 'zoho.com', 'gmx.com', 'gmx.de',
    'inbox.com', 'live.com', 'msn.com', 'me.com', 'mac.com',
    
    // Privacy-focused
    'proton.me', 'tutanota.com', 'pm.me', 'tutamail.com',
    
    // Other free services
    'fastmail.com', 'hushmail.com', 'mail.ru', 'web.de',
    'qq.com', '163.com', '126.com', 'sina.com', 'rediffmail.com'
  ];

  // ============================================
  // VALIDATION FUNCTIONS
  // ============================================

  function isFreeEmail(email) {
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) return true;
    const domain = email.split('@')[1].toLowerCase();
    return freeEmailDomains.includes(domain);
  }

  function isValidEmailFormat(email) {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    return emailRegex.test(email);
  }

  // ============================================
  // UI FUNCTIONS
  // ============================================

  function showError(input, message) {
    removeError(input);
    
    const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
    errorDiv.className = 'business-email-error';
    
    // Apply error styling
    Object.assign(errorDiv.style, CONFIG.errorStyle);
    errorDiv.textContent = message;
    
    // Insert error after input
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(errorDiv, input.nextSibling);
    
    // Apply error styling to input
    Object.assign(input.style, CONFIG.inputErrorStyle);
  }

  function removeError(input) {
    const errorDiv = input.parentNode.querySelector('.business-email-error');
    if (errorDiv) {
      errorDiv.remove();
    }
    
    // Reset input styling
    input.style.borderColor = '';
    input.style.borderWidth = '';
    input.style.borderStyle = '';
  }

  function toggleSubmitButton(form, disable) {
    if (!form) return;
    
    // Find submit button (input or button type)
    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('input[type="submit"], button[type="submit"], .pop-up-submit-button');
    
    if (submitBtn) {
      submitBtn.disabled = disable;
      
      if (disable) {
        Object.assign(submitBtn.style, CONFIG.submitDisabledStyle);
        submitBtn.setAttribute('data-business-email-disabled', 'true');
      } else {
        // Reset to original styling
        submitBtn.style.opacity = '';
        submitBtn.style.cursor = '';
        submitBtn.style.pointerEvents = '';
        submitBtn.removeAttribute('data-business-email-disabled');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // VALIDATION LOGIC
  // ============================================

  function validateBusinessEmail(input, showErrors = true) {
    const email = input.value.trim();
    const form = input.closest('form');
    
    // Empty field
    if (!email) {
      if (showErrors) {
        removeError(input);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Invalid email format
    if (!isValidEmailFormat(email)) {
      if (showErrors) {
        showError(input, CONFIG.errorMessages.invalid);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Free email check
    if (isFreeEmail(email)) {
      if (showErrors) {
        showError(input, CONFIG.errorMessages.freeEmail);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Valid business email
    removeError(input);
    toggleSubmitButton(form, false);
    return true;
  }

  // ============================================
  // EVENT HANDLERS
  // ============================================

  function setupInputValidation(input) {
    const form = input.closest('form');
    
    // Disable submit initially if empty
    if (!input.value.trim()) {
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
    } else {
      // Validate existing value
      validateBusinessEmail(input, false);
    }
    
    // Real-time validation on input
    if (CONFIG.realtimeValidation) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        validateBusinessEmail(this, true);
      });
    }
    
    // Validation on blur
    if (CONFIG.validateOnBlur) {
      input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        if (this.value.trim()) {
          validateBusinessEmail(this, true);
        }
      });
    }
    
    // Prevent form submission if invalid
    if (form && !form.hasAttribute('data-business-email-validation')) {
      form.setAttribute('data-business-email-validation', 'true');
      
      form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        const businessEmailInputs = this.querySelectorAll('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field');
        let allValid = true;
        
        businessEmailInputs.forEach(inp => {
          if (!validateBusinessEmail(inp, true)) {
            allValid = false;
          }
        });
        
        if (!allValid) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          return false;
        }
      }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure this runs first
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // INITIALIZATION
  // ============================================

  function initializeValidation() {
    // Find all business email inputs (supporting both spellings of the class)
    const businessEmailInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field');
    
    businessEmailInputs.forEach(input => {
      // Check if already initialized
      if (!input.hasAttribute('data-business-email-initialized')) {
        input.setAttribute('data-business-email-initialized', 'true');
        setupInputValidation(input);
      }
    });
  }

  // Initialize on DOM ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeValidation);
  } else {
    initializeValidation();
  }

  // Watch for dynamically added forms
  const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
    let shouldInit = false;
    mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
      if (mutation.addedNodes.length) {
        mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1) { // Element node
            if (node.matches('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field') ||
                node.querySelector('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field')) {
              shouldInit = true;
            }
          }
        });
      }
    });
    if (shouldInit) {
      initializeValidation();
    }
  });

  observer.observe(document.body, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });

  // Expose validation function globally if needed
  window.validateBusinessEmail = validateBusinessEmail;

})();

function initMaskTextScrollReveal() {

          }
        });

    })

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  // Target the Webflow slider
  const slider = $('.testimonial-slider');
  const leftArrow = slider.find('.left-arrow');
  const rightArrow = slider.find('.right-arrow');
  const slides = slider.find('.w-slide');
  const dots = slider.find('.w-slider-dot');
  
  // Find the SVG paths inside the arrows
  const leftArrowPaths = leftArrow.find('svg path');
  const rightArrowPaths = rightArrow.find('svg path');
  
  // Store original arrow colors from the SVG paths
  const leftOriginalColor = leftArrowPaths.first().attr('fill') || leftArrowPaths.first().attr('stroke') || '#ffffff';
  const rightOriginalColor = rightArrowPaths.first().attr('fill') || rightArrowPaths.first().attr('stroke') || '#ffffff';
  
  // Function to update arrow colors and disable/enable based on active slide
  function updateArrowColors() {
    const activeDotIndex = dots.index($('.w-slider-dot.w-active'));
    const totalSlides = slides.length;
    
    // If at first slide, gray out and disable left arrow
    if (activeDotIndex === 0) {
      leftArrowPaths.attr('fill', '#AFAFAF');
      leftArrowPaths.attr('stroke', '#AFAFAF');
      leftArrowPaths.css({'fill': '#AFAFAF', 'stroke': '#AFAFAF'});
      leftArrow.css({'pointer-events': 'none', 'cursor': 'default'});
    } else {
      leftArrowPaths.attr('fill', leftOriginalColor);
      leftArrowPaths.attr('stroke', leftOriginalColor);
      leftArrowPaths.css({'fill': leftOriginalColor, 'stroke': leftOriginalColor});
      leftArrow.css({'pointer-events': 'auto', 'cursor': 'pointer'});
    }
    
    // If at last slide, gray out and disable right arrow
    if (activeDotIndex === totalSlides - 1) {
      rightArrowPaths.attr('fill', '#AFAFAF');
      rightArrowPaths.attr('stroke', '#AFAFAF');
      rightArrowPaths.css({'fill': '#AFAFAF', 'stroke': '#AFAFAF'});
      rightArrow.css({'pointer-events': 'none', 'cursor': 'default'});
    } else {
      rightArrowPaths.attr('fill', rightOriginalColor);
      rightArrowPaths.attr('stroke', rightOriginalColor);
      rightArrowPaths.css({'fill': rightOriginalColor, 'stroke': rightOriginalColor});
      rightArrow.css({'pointer-events': 'auto', 'cursor': 'pointer'});
    }
  }
  
  // Run on page load
  setTimeout(updateArrowColors, 100);
  
  // Update when arrows are clicked
  leftArrow.on('click', function() {
    setTimeout(updateArrowColors, 350);
  });
  
  rightArrow.on('click', function() {
    setTimeout(updateArrowColors, 350);
  });
  
  // Update when dots are clicked
  dots.on('click', function() {
    setTimeout(updateArrowColors, 350);
  });
  
  // Monitor for class changes on dots (for autoplay)
  const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
    updateArrowColors();
  });
  
  dots.each(function() {
    observer.observe(this, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  });
});
</script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Get all videos with class 'tab-video'
  const videos = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-video');
  
  videos.forEach(function(video, index) {
    // Hide placeholder when video is ready
    const placeholder = video.parentElement.querySelector('.video-placeholder');
    
    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', function() {
      if (placeholder) {
        placeholder.classList.add('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => placeholder.remove(), 300);
      }
    }, { once: true });
    
    // Ensure video doesn't autoplay on page load
    video.autoplay = false;
    
    // Set ONLY the first video to start at 6 seconds
    if (index === 0) {
      video.currentTime = 6;
      video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function() {
        if (video.currentTime === 0) {
          video.currentTime = 6;
        }
      }, { once: true });
    }
    
    // Track if user manually paused the video
    let userPaused = false;
    let manualControlLock = false;
    let lockTimeout = null;
    
    // Detect clicks on video controls (play/pause button specifically)
    video.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      // User clicked somewhere on the video player
      const rect = video.getBoundingClientRect();
      const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const controlsHeight = 50; // Approximate height of controls bar
      
      // If clicked in controls area (bottom of video)
      if (clickY > rect.height - controlsHeight) {
        // Activate manual control lock for 5 seconds
        manualControlLock = true;
        
        // Clear existing timeout
        if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
        
        // Set new timeout
        lockTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          manualControlLock = false;
        }, 5000); // 5 second lock
      }
    });
    
    // Listen for manual pause by user (via controls)
    video.addEventListener('pause', function(e) {
      // If user paused manually, respect it
      if (!video.ended) {
        userPaused = true;
        
        // Activate lock when user pauses
        manualControlLock = true;
        if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
        lockTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          manualControlLock = false;
        }, 5000);
      }
    });
    
    // Listen for manual play by user
    video.addEventListener('play', function() {
      userPaused = false;
      
      // Activate lock when user plays
      manualControlLock = true;
      if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
      lockTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        manualControlLock = false;
      }, 5000);
    });
    
    // Function to check if video's tab is active
    function isVideoInActiveTab(videoElement) {
      // Check if video is inside a hidden tab pane (Webflow uses w--tab-active class)
      const tabPane = videoElement.closest('[data-w-tab]');
      if (tabPane) {
        return tabPane.classList.contains('w--tab-active');
      }
      // If no tab structure found, assume it's active
      return true;
    }
    
    // Intersection Observer to play/pause when video enters/exits viewport
    const observerOptions = {
      root: null,
      rootMargin: '0px',
      threshold: 0.5 // Video must be 50% visible to play
    };
    
    const observerCallback = (entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        // Use requestAnimationFrame for smoother video state changes
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && isVideoInActiveTab(video)) {
            // Video is in view AND in active tab
            // Only auto-play if user hasn't manually paused it AND lock is not active
            if (!userPaused && !manualControlLock) {
              video.play().catch(error => {
                console.log('Play failed:', error);
              });
            }
          } else {
            // Video is out of view OR in inactive tab - pause it
            video.pause();
            // Reset userPaused and lock when video leaves viewport
            userPaused = false;
            manualControlLock = false;
            if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
          }
        });
      });
    };
    
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(observerCallback, observerOptions);
    observer.observe(video);
    
    // Listen for tab changes (Webflow tabs) - Use event delegation for better performance
    const tabChangeHandler = function(e) {
      // Check if a tab link was clicked
      if (e.target.closest('[data-w-tab]') || e.target.hasAttribute('data-w-tab')) {
        // Small delay to let Webflow update the active tab
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (!isVideoInActiveTab(video)) {
            video.pause();
            userPaused = false;
            manualControlLock = false;
            if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
          } else {
            // Trigger intersection observer check when tab becomes active
            observer.unobserve(video);
            observer.observe(video);
          }
        }, 50);
      }
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('click', tabChangeHandler);
    
    // Clean up on page unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
      observer.disconnect();
      document.removeEventListener('click', tabChangeHandler);
      if (lockTimeout) clearTimeout(lockTimeout);
    });
